}}According to legend, '''Ghoetam''' was a sage who sat beneath [[Avendesora]] for forty years to gain wisdom.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Ghoetam}} When Rand and Mat arrive at Avendesora, Rand begins to feel the effects of [[chora]] trees and can well believe the tale of Ghoetam.{{ref/book|4|24}}

==Parallel==
This legend is a parallel of [[Wikipedia:Gautama Buddha|Gautama Buddha]] who sat in meditation underneath the [[Wikipedia:Bodhi Tree|Bodhi Tree]] for forty-nine days to achieve enlightenment and a knowledge of the Truth.
